name: demucs
license_scope_evidence: GitHub repository metadata reports MIT; the pinned README says Demucs is released under the MIT license; the pinned root LICENSE is the MIT text.
attribution_requirements: Retain the Meta Platforms copyright and MIT permission notice when redistributing copied material.
intended_use: Offline reference for chunking, overlap-add reconstruction, normalization boundaries, and separation evaluation. Do not treat Demucs as AudioShield's semantic target separator.

model_weights.name: Pretrained Demucs .th checkpoints listed by the pinned remote manifest
model_weights.evidence: demucs/pretrained.py constructs download URLs under dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/demucs/ and the remote manifest lists .th files, but neither the pinned repository nor the host path exposes an explicit license covering those checkpoint artifacts. The repository MIT license is not treated as a model-weight license.
model_weights.action: Do not download, copy, package, or ship these checkpoints from this intake folder until an explicit artifact license is independently verified.

useful_files.purpose: TensorChunk padding, model segment splitting, triangular transition weights, weighted overlap-add, shift averaging, and center trimming.
useful_files.modification_required: A future adapter would need framework-independent buffering, browser-safe memory/latency limits, explicit target-query semantics, and tests for stream boundaries. No modification was made here.

useful_files.purpose: MDX-style nSDR calculation, museval BSS evaluation, and track-level aggregation around separated estimates.
useful_files.modification_required: Replace MUSDB/museval assumptions with AudioShield mixture/target/reference fixtures and report target leakage, preserved-speech quality, latency, and clipping. No modification was made here.

useful_files.purpose: Center trimming and frame-unfolding helpers used by the apply/evaluation path, plus a synchronous pool pattern for deterministic offline work.
useful_files.expected_audioShield_destination: Offline evaluation and chunk-boundary test reference only.
useful_files.modification_required: Any future port must be rewritten for the selected browser runtime and must preserve exact sample-count behavior. No modification was made here.

inspected_not_copied.reason: Useful channel conversion and clipping/normalization observations, but it is coupled to ffmpeg, torchaudio, julius, lameenc, and file I/O; it is not a minimal browser component.
Dataset loading and whole-track normalization are coupled to MUSDB/torchaudio and are not suitable for the extension runtime.
Pretrained download and model-loading path points at separately licensed/unknown .th artifacts; it is intentionally not copied.
Full music separator architecture is far beyond the minimal intake and has no semantic target-class conditioning.

embedded_attributions.attribution: The new_sdr helper comments that it is adapted from AIcrowd/music-demixing-challenge-starter-kit under MIT.
embedded_attributions.action: Retain the upstream attribution comment if this reference is adapted later; no AIcrowd source file was copied.

provenance_verification: The copied source files and LICENSE were copied byte-for-byte from the pinned commit; local SHA-256 hashes and upstream Git blob SHA-1 values are recorded above. No model weights or production AudioShield files were copied or modified.
